text:
maya: Quick check — running into flaky streaming when client hits a private endpoint via our proxy/VPC. Streams start fine but drop after ~30s with 502/504 or ECONNRESET. Happening on both node and python SDKs. Anyone else seen this?

thomas: saw something similar in staging yesterday, probably proxy idle timeout / keepalive mismatch. @maya can you paste the client config and the base_url you’re using?

maya: config snippet: REDWOOD_BASE_URL=https://private.redwood.internal
SDK: node 18 + our SDK v2
client opts: { baseUrl: process.env.REDWOOD_BASE_URL, httpAgent: new Agent({ keepAlive: true }) }
curl example I used to repro:
```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Host: private.redwood.internal' 'https://edge-proxy.company/v1/stream'
```

alex: stacktrace or response headers would help. once we saw `connection: close` from the proxy after an auth refresh and that killed the stream.

li: FYI python aiohttp had a default tcp keepalive ~30s; try increasing keepalive_timeout or setting it to 0. also check if mTLS sidecar redoes handshake on cert rotation (that can reset sockets).

sam: could be host header rewrite — private endpoints expect the original Host. our edge proxy sometimes rewrites host to the upstream host which breaks HTTP/1.1 streaming. try forcing the Host header in the client.

maya: added Host header explicitly, still intermittent. minimal client log:
```text
[2026-03-17T14:05:23.123Z] connect -> 200
[2026-03-17T14:05:53.456Z] stream: error ECONNRESET
response headers: server: edge-proxy/1.4.2
x-proxy-id: pxy-9
```

devex-bot: devex-bot: If this blocks users create an incident ticket with category=devex/vpc and paste the logs. See /incidents template.

thomas: maya can you try curl with explicit HTTP/1.1 and Connection: keep-alive header, also try `--no-keepalive` to experiment. also try `--http2` to see different behavior.

alex: I can reproduce with node when using http.Agent keepAlive:true + proxy CONNECT. setting keepAlive:false made it stable locally (but bad perf). suggests we need a reconnect strategy in SDK for streaming.

li: infra note: private endpoint LB idle timeout is 60s but the proxy default is 32s — mismatch leads to resets. I’ll open an ops ticket to increase proxy timeout for private endpoints to 70s.

maya: filed ops ticket #4321 (ops/infra) and created a draft PR in sdk-node to add stream reconnect hooks — pinging @alex for review. repro steps + logs in gist: https://gist.github.com/xxx

sam: I’ll loop in eng-infra to check proxy timeouts and mTLS sidecar rotation schedule. will report back here. :thumbsup:

thomas: next steps: 1) infra bump proxy timeout for private endpoints, 2) sdk add reconnect/backoff and doc guidance, 3) add Host-header examples in client docs. I can create the issues if folks agree.

maya: thanks — leaving this thread open until infra change lands. will post results and mark ticket when verified.
